method.all_gold: all case gold minus disputed; includes non-judgment rules
method.card_source_gold: all_gold and deliveries intersect the 112 approved card source_rule_ids; selection-only comparison, not a current judgment census
method.epoch: fresh independent session/boot per case; Joe personal scope
method.events: prompt plus recorded PreToolUse only; core excluded
method.limitations: selected source IDs, not semantic equivalence, full-text receipt success, or adherence; no model calls; no held-out tuning
method.precision: allowed delivered IDs / labelled delivered IDs; pending IDs ungraded
method.recall: source-rule ID intersections; case-level unions, then micro counts
